info.title: How modifier groups work
info.intro: A modifier group is a question you ask the customer. The modifiers are the answers they can pick from.
info.step1: Create a group and set its rule: required or optional, and how many choices.
info.step2: Add the choices (modifiers), each with an optional price change.
info.step3: Open a product and tick the group to attach it.
info.example: Example: the group “Size” (required, pick 1) holds Small, Medium and Large. Tick it on every pizza.

form.requiredHelp: On: the customer has to pick at least one choice before ordering (for example a size). Off: the choices are optional extras.
form.maxHelp: The most choices the customer can pick from this group. Use 1 for “pick one”, or a higher number for extras.
form.modifiersHelp: The options the customer picks from, such as Small, Medium, Large. The price change is added to the product price (leave 0 for free).
form.modifiersLaterHint: To change the choices, use “Manage modifiers” on the group card.
